correctness.rationale: PASS: For the exact degree<=2 edge-subset complex on the 21-edge Heawood graph, independent full 2^21-mask enumeration yields 447859 nonempty faces and the stated 14-entry face vector. Successive edge-toggle matching yields 223925 pairs with exactly one critical vertex, one 9-cell and seven 10-cells; standard patchwork makes it acyclic. Independent signed algebraic Morse elimination calculates the complete row (1,1,0,0,0,-1,1), primitive over Z; cellular cancellation converts the unique 9-cell plus one 10-cell to contractible pair and leaves six S10. Euler characteristic 7 is consistent. This is an exhaustive fixed graph certificate, not an infinite family proof.

Published ordinary matching complex of Heawood, 3-cut complexes and perfect matching complexes have DIFFERENT face definitions, cannot imply M2(H).
